title: Talent Acquistion Lead
jobDescription:
Position Overview We are looking for a Talent Acquisition Lead with 8-10 years of experience in recruiting, preferably in high-growth technology startups. The ideal candidate will have demonstrated success in scaling Engineering, Product, and Business teams while partnering closely with business leaders to build high-performing organizations. This role requires someone who combines strong execution with strategic thinking
- someone who can own the end-to-end hiring process, influence hiring decisions through data, and continuously improve recruitment processes. The successful candidate will act as a trusted advisor to hiring managers, build scalable hiring practices, and drive an exceptional candidate experience while strengthening the company's employer brand. About the Role As the Talent Acquisition Lead, you will own end-to-end hiring across critical business functions with a strong focus on Engineering and Product hiring. You will collaborate closely with hiring managers and leadership to understand workforce plans, develop effective hiring strategies, and ensure timely delivery against business goals. This role also involves driving recruitment process improvements, building talent pipelines, leveraging recruitment analytics, and continuously enhancing candidate and stakeholder experience. Key Responsibilities
1. Strategic Talent Acquisition Own end-to-end recruitment across Engineering, Product, and business functions. Partner with business leaders to understand hiring priorities, organizational structure, and workforce planning. Develop role-specific sourcing strategies to attract high-quality talent in competitive markets. Drive hiring plans while balancing speed, quality, and candidate experience. Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle including sourcing, screening, interviewing, offer management, and onboarding coordination.
2. Stakeholder & Business Partnership Serve as a trusted recruitment partner to hiring managers and leadership teams. Advise stakeholders on talent availability, market trends, compensation benchmarks, and hiring strategies. Drive structured interview processes and ensure consistency in candidate evaluation. Provide regular hiring updates, pipeline insights, and recommendations using recruitment metrics.
3. Talent Pipeline & Employer Branding Build proactive talent pipelines through Linked In Recruiter, referrals, networking, market mapping, and other sourcing channels. Strengthen employer branding through candidate engagement initiatives, social media, employee referrals, and recruitment campaigns. Build relationships with passive talent for future hiring needs. Ensure a seamless and positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment journey.
4. Recruitment Operations & Process Excellence Identify opportunities to improve recruitment processes, workflows, and hiring efficiency. Build and maintain recruitment dashboards, hiring metrics, and reports to enable data-driven decision making. Ensure recruitment documentation, interview feedback, and ATS records remain accurate and compliant. Drive process standardization and continuously improve hiring SLAs and quality metrics.
5. Team Collaboration Collaborate with internal recruiters, external agencies, and cross-functional teams to achieve hiring goals. Share sourcing best practices and market intelligence across the recruitment team. Support recruitment initiatives including referral programs, campus hiring, and diversity hiring where applicable. Preferred Qualifications 8-10 years of Talent Acquisition experience, preferably in startups or high-growth technology companies. Proven experience hiring for Engineering, Product, and business functions. Strong expertise in sourcing passive talent using Linked In Recruiter and other modern sourcing channels. Experience partnering with senior stakeholders and influencing hiring decisions. Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and negotiation skills. Strong analytical mindset with experience using recruitment metrics to improve hiring outcomes. Familiarity with ATS platforms and recruitment tools. Ability to manage multiple hiring priorities in a fast-paced environment.

title: Senior Technical Recruiter
jobDescription:
You will be responsible for sourcing, assessing, and hiring exceptional talent to fuel our company’s growth. You will work closely with hiring managers to understand the unique needs of our Tech & Product teams and help find the best candidates to drive our mission forward. Your role will involve managing the full recruitment lifecycle, from identifying potential candidates to onboarding. As a Senior TA in Arisinfra you will
- ● Manage the full-cycle recruitment process, from job postings and sourcing to interviews and offer extensions. ● Utilize various sourcing methods, including job boards, social media, and networking, to identify top candidates. ● Maintain and optimize the applicant tracking system (ATS), ensuring efficiency for hiring managers and employees. ● Build and implement key recruitment metrics for all tech hiring efforts. ● Provide regular reports and updates to stakeholders on hiring progress, challenges, and insights. ● Consult and collaborate with senior leadership and hiring managers to develop strategic hiring plans. ● Proactively source, screen, and engage both passive and active candidates. ● Review resumes and conduct phone screens to assess candidates’ knowledge, experience, motivation, and overall fit. ● Maintain a candidate database and track recruitment performance metrics to drive continuous improvement. ● Ensure an exceptional candidate experience throughout the hiring process. Skills Required
- ● 3-5 years of experience in end-to-end Tech & Product recruitment. ● Strong understanding of recruitment best practices, hiring strategies, and talent acquisition trends. ● Exceptional communication and interpersonal skills. ● Proven ability to source and attract top-tier talent in competitive markets. ● Strong analytical skills to interpret recruiting data and refine hiring processes.

title: UI/UX Designer
jobDescription: About ARIS At ARIS, we’re on a mission to make construction simple, reliable and scalable — combining deep domain expertise with cutting-edge technology. This isn’t a marketplace or a layer on top of existing systems; we’re building the underlying technology that powers logistics, credit decisions, and compliance at scale. Our platform runs live operations across 900+ pin codes and supports real-time tracking, automated documentation, and financial decisioning across a large supply chain. Performance, reliability, and correctness matter here. We believe that technology and product are two sides of the same coin: precision in code and empathy for the end user. Role Description We are seeking a skilled UI/UX Designer to join our dynamic tech and product team. You will own the design of meaningful features end-to-end across our web and mobile applications — from early problem framing through to polished, shipped interfaces — working closely with product managers, engineers, and fellow designers to take ideas from concept to launch. This role suits a creative problem-solver with strong design fundamentals and 2–5 years of experience — someone ready to take ownership, work fast, and use AI as a core part of how they design, not just what they design for. What You’ll Do As a UI/UX Designer, you will: Design user-centred experiences for web and mobile applications, translating product requirements into clear UX flows, wireframes, and polished, high-fidelity UI. Take complex, data-heavy workflows — multi-step flows, real-time tracking, documentation, and analytics dashboards — and make them clear, elegant, and easy to use. Build interactive prototypes to communicate interaction and behaviour, and pressure-test ideas before they reach engineering. Conduct user research and usability testing, analyse feedback, and identify friction in workflows to iterate toward simpler, better experiences. Partner with Product to define user problems, shape feature direction, and influence the roadmap. Work closely with engineers to understand system architecture and constraints, and deliver designs that ship at high quality. Evolve and maintain our design system and component libraries, ensuring consistency and brand adherence across features and platforms. Actively participate in design discussions, reviews, and critiques — clearly articulating your design decisions and rationale. What We’re Looking For 2–4 years of experience in UX/UI or interaction design, ideally in a product-driven environment. A strong portfolio demonstrating structured thinking, end-to-end execution, and complex web or mobile application design. Strong proficiency in Figma; familiarity with tools like Framer is a plus. Hands-on use of the latest gen AI tools as a core part of the design workflow. A solid grasp of user-centred design principles, interaction design, responsive design, and usability testing. Strong visual design sense and exceptional attention to detail. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale to cross-functional stakeholders. An ownership mindset and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, agile environment while managing multiple priorities. A degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). Nice to Have Experience designing data-heavy, workflow-driven, or technically sophisticated products. Experience simplifying complex systems for non-technical or semi-technical users. Experience designing for logistics, supply chain, fintech, or other operationally complex domains. Exposure to AI-native products such as intelligent automation, anomaly detection, or computer vision.

title: Engineering Lead
jobDescription:
We are looking for a Engineering Leader to lead the next phase of Aris Infra’s technology evolution. This is a strategic leadership role responsible for scaling our engineering organization, re-architecting systems for national growth, embedding AI-driven intelligence into our platform, and building a resilient, high-performance technology foundation. You will work closely with the executive team and play a central role in shaping ARIS into a category-defining infra-tech platform. What You’ll Do
1. Engineering Vision & Strategy Define and execute the long-term technology roadmap aligned with business objectives. Transition and scale the current MVP architecture into a robust, modular, and enterprise-grade platform. Establish engineering best practices across architecture, security, Dev Ops, QA, and reliability. Drive a tech-first culture that prioritizes innovation, speed, ownership, and accountability. Partner with Product, Finance, Supply, and Operations leaders to deliver measurable business impact.
2. Platform Architecture & Scalability Architect systems for high availability, scalability, and resilience. Lead modernization of backend and frontend systems. Drive cloud-native infrastructure (AWS preferred). Ensure strong data infrastructure for real-time visibility, reporting, and analytics. Implement robust Dev Ops, CI/CD, and monitoring frameworks.
3. AI & Data Intelligence At ARIS, technology is not just about digitization
- it is about intelligence. You will lead the integration of AI and advanced analytics across the platform, including: Predictive demand forecasting and supply optimization. AI-driven pricing intelligence and margin optimization. Intelligent credit underwriting and risk modeling for embedded finance. Automation of procurement workflows using AI-led orchestration. Leveraging Gen AI to improve internal productivity, decision-making, and customer experience. Building scalable ML pipelines and production-ready model deployment frameworks. Your mandate is to make ARIS not just tech-enabled
- but intelligence-driven What You’ll Do
1. Product Engineering & Delivery Oversee the full product development lifecycle from ideation to deployment. Deliver high-quality, secure, and performant products on schedule. Design intuitive user experiences for complex procurement and financing workflows. Ensure strong alignment between product roadmap and engineering execution. Introduce metrics-driven engineering processes to track velocity, reliability, and business impact.
2. Team Building & Leadership Build and scale a high-performing engineering team. Hire, mentor, and develop strong technical leaders. Establish a culture of technical excellence and first-principles thinking. Foster cross-functional collaboration and transparency. Create succession and leadership depth within the engineering organization. What We’re Looking For
1. Technical Expertise Strong computer science fundamentals and system design expertise. 8-12 years of experience in software engineering, with significant leadership experience. Hands-on experience building enterprise-grade systems in: Backend: Java, Node.js, or equivalent Frontend: React or modern frameworks Experience with distributed systems and scalable architectures. Cloud-native experience (AWS preferred). Exposure to data platforms, analytics systems, and ML deployment frameworks. Full-stack experience is a plus.
2. Leadership Experience Proven experience leading engineering teams in high-growth environments. Experience scaling products from MVP to large-scale production systems. Experience working closely with executive leadership. Demonstrated ability to translate business goals into technical execution. Mindset & Attributes Builder mentality with strong ownership orientation. Data-driven decision maker. Comfortable operating in ambiguity and high-growth environments. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. Passion for solving systemic, real-world problems using technology Why Work at Aris Infra Lead technology transformation in India’s infrastructure ecosystem. Build and scale a platform operating at national scale. Shape AI-led innovation in procurement and embedded finance. Work directly with leadership to influence company strategy. Build something meaningful in a large, high-impact industry.

title: Software Development Engineer IV
jobDescription:
Aris is building core infrastructure for how construction materials are sourced, financed, and moved across India. This isn’t a marketplace or a layer on top of existing systems, we’re building the underlying technology that powers logistics, credit decisions, and compliance at scale. Our platform runs live operations across 900+ pin codes and supports real-time tracking, automated documentation, and financial decisioning across a large supply chain. Performance, reliability, and correctness matter here
- this is backend-heavy work where systems operate continuously and at scale. As a Principal Engineer at Aris, you’ll be responsible for driving engineering excellence and strengthening our digital infrastructure platform that supports one of India’s fastest-growing construction supply ecosystems. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to build scalable, reliable, and secure solutions that power core capabilities such as automated procurement, real-time delivery tracking, credit risk scoring, and end-to-end supply chain digitisation. Key Responsibilities Technical Delivery & Engineering Design, develop and deploy scalable microservices supporting procurement workflows, vendor matching, and delivery management. Build backend systems optimized for heavy transactional load and real-time data processing, enabling procurement decisions in minutes. Ensure efficient and resilient integrations with internal services (e.g., order processing, documentation digitisation) and external vendor systems/APIs. Implement event-driven architectures using message brokers, queues or streaming platforms to handle high-throughput vendor and material data. Data, Intelligence & Automation Leverage machine learning models and AI algorithms to optimize vendor recommendations and demand forecasting. Implement real-time analytics dashboards, alerting systems, and performance telemetry for business and operational metrics. Contribute to data pipeline architectures and ETL processes that power analytics, credit risk scoring, and supply chain intelligence. Platform Reliability & Operations Apply best practices in Dev Ops and CI/CD pipelines for rapid code delivery with automated testing, security scans, and deployment automation. Enhance observability through metrics, logs, tracing, and anomaly detection tools to maintain high availability of mission-critical systems. Collaborate with Dev Ops and SRE teams to ensure performance at scale with minimal downtime. Security, Compliance & Quality Champion secure coding practices and enforce compliance with data protection, confidentiality, and source control protocols. Conduct code reviews, performance profiling, and automated security testing to uphold engineering standards. Required Skills & Experience Technical Expertise Proven experience in backend development with Node.js / Python / Java / Go and building RESTful or Graph QL APIs. Strong fundamentals in distributed systems, cloud architecture (AWS/GCP/Azure), and containerization (Docker, Kubernetes). Experience with stream processing technologies (e.g., Kafka), database technologies (SQL and No SQL), and caching layers. Familiarity with event-driven design patterns, messaging systems, and asynchronous processing. Adept at designing secure and scalable CI/CD workflows and infrastructure as code (Ia C) using Terraform/Cloud Formation. Analytical & Problem Solving Ability to model complex business problems into reliable engineering solutions. Experience with performance tuning and capacity planning in high-throughput systems. Why Work at Aris High-impact ownership: Build and scale core backend services powering procurement, logistics, payments, and compliance. Complex systems at scale: Solve real production challenges across distributed systems handling high-volume transactions. Applied AI: Integrate ML into pricing, credit risk, logistics optimisation, and fraud detection workflows. Strong engineering practices: Work with cloud-native systems, CI/CD, infra-as-code, and structured design reviews. Builder mindset: Hands-on role with deep ownership, collaborating closely with junior engineers and leadership.
